Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# When a release occurs, do a full matrix build (duplicated logic from
# build.yml), name the artifacts appropriately, and upload them to
# the release.

name: Upload Release Builds

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  Build-and-upload-release-builds:
    name: ${{ matrix.config.os }}-${{matrix.config.build-type}}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.config.os }}
    permissions:
      contents: write # release changes require contents write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # We can't properly align to the VFX Reference Platform as this
        # requires glibc 2.28, which is older than the closest matching
        # Linux environment (Ubuntu 22.04 with glibc 2.35).
        config:
          # No Windows debug, Dosen't work on actions (easily)
          # It's hard to get a python debug lib.
        - os: windows-2022
          preamble: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Enterprise\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64
          shell: cmd
          build-type: RelWithDebInfo
        - os: windows-2022
          preamble: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Enterprise\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64
          shell: cmd
          build-type: Release
        - os: ubuntu-22.04
          shell: bash
          build-type: Debug
        - os: ubuntu-22.04
          shell: bash
          build-type: RelWithDebInfo
        - os: ubuntu-22.04
          shell: bash
          build-type: Release
        - os: macos-14
          shell: bash
          build-type: Debug
        - os: macos-14
          shell: bash
          build-type: RelWithDebInfo
        - os: macos-14
          shell: bash
          build-type: Release
    defaults:
      run:
        # Annoyingly required here since `matrix` isn't available in
        # the `shell` property of individual steps.
        shell: ${{ matrix.config.shell }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Bootstrap
        uses: ./.github/bootstrap_platform

      # We don't want to publish the test build, it gets too big.
      - name: Build and Install (No tests)
        run: >
          ${{ matrix.config.preamble }}

          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DOPENASSETIO_ENABLE_SIMPLECPPMANAGER=ON -DOPENASSETIO_TEST_CPP_PLUGINS_SUBDIR=lib/OpenAssetIO/plugins
          --install-prefix ${{ github.workspace }}/dist/${{ matrix.config.os }}${{ matrix.config.build-type }}
          --toolchain ${{ github.workspace }}/.conan/conan_paths.cmake
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{matrix.config.build-type}}

          cmake --build build

          cmake --install build

      - name: Get compiler information
        id: compiler_info
        shell: bash
        # Search the cmake info for the compiler information, remove the
        # env var labels, and dequote it.
        run: |
          cd build
          compiler_version=$(cmake --system-information | grep -E "^CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION " | cut -d ' ' -f2 | tr -d '"')
          compiler_id=$(cmake --system-information | grep -E "^CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID " | cut -d ' ' -f2 | tr -d '"')
          python_version=$(python -V | sed 's/ /-/')
          echo "compiler_version=$compiler_version" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "compiler_id=$compiler_id" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "python_version=$python_version" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Bundle and Upload Artifact
        #Use inbuilt powershell commands because `zip` isn't on windows.

results.content:
Skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs

Pattern: P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW (workflow_skip)

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

Contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute

Method: Treat as behavior-changing rather than a safe default; Require evidence about affected checks

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

Reported metrics: {"comparison": "less_than", "paid_vm_time_reduction_upper_bound_percent": 0.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.4; Table 4; PDF pp. 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Literature example before:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
trigger CI for each submitted revision


Literature example after:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
omit a revision only under an approved skip policy


Literature example diff:

--- knowledge/examples/P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW/before.txt
+++ knowledge/examples/P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW/after.txt
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 # ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
-trigger CI for each submitted revision
+omit a revision only under an approved skip policy
contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute
preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

results.content:
Cache dependency downloads

Pattern: P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency_cache)

When is cache dependency downloads applicable?

Assess cache dependency downloads for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repeated dependency fetching is measurable; Cache inputs include lockfile and environment

Contraindications: Mutable or untrusted cached content; An equivalent cache already exists

Method: Choose dependency download state rather than unchecked build outputs; Keep installation and all required tests

Reported finding: Caching has modest aggregate benefit.

Reported metrics: {"vm_time_reduction_percent": {"free": 6, "paid": 3.4}}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.1; Table 4; PDF pp. 6, 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Literature example before:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
download dependencies
install dependencies
run required checks


Literature example after:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
restore dependency downloads by lockfile and environment
install dependencies
run required checks


Literature example diff:

--- knowledge/examples/P-LIT-GHA-CACHE/before.txt
+++ knowledge/examples/P-LIT-GHA-CACHE/after.txt
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 # ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
-download dependencies
+restore dependency downloads by lockfile and environment
 install dependencies
 run required checks
preconditions: Cache inputs include lockfile and environment
